metadata.title: 4 Robot Policies Datagen Benchmark (224 Trials)
metadata.reproducibility: Policy RNG has seed; MPPI is not bit-exact
metadata.freeze_definition: v < 0.05 m/s continuously >= 3.0s while d_human > 2.0m (excluding standstill before motion start and after goal reached)
metadata.stopped_definition: v < 0.05 m/s continuously >= 1.0s (excluding standstill before motion start and after goal reached)
